strongest_counter_argument: The differential claim - reading candidate text beats similarity-ranked stacks - rests on a comparison the authors constructed. Track C is an in-house reproduction: top-2 packing (~2.8k chars of a nominal 4,000-char window); the two abstentions giving Track A its only accuracy win are as consistent with packing depth as with the asserted chunking cause, and the repo's own ANALYSIS.md records a same-day top-10 Track C at 10/10 with zero abstentions - a sensitivity the paper never reports. Track B, tied 10/10 with no gate, is characterized as 'reading whole files' though traces show one agent call per question with files_used model-asserted; the corpus is canonical papers the answering LLM knows parametrically, a confound no track controls. The headline 'answered on target 10/10' has no judge or rubric; the honesty paragraph vouches only for gate scores. A checkable mislabel: BQ01's missing keyword sits in Confidence, not Blind Spots. Abstention is a contract success for A but 'failed twice' for C. Each flaw is a wording fix; together they show framing outrunning traces.
overall: The paper survives better than most demo submissions - honesty checks, latency-scope labels, and published traces preempt several lines - but three framing failures are real (Track B characterization + parametric confound; Track C abstention mechanism asserted with unreported packing sensitivity; unjudged 'on target' row) plus one checkably wrong section attribution (BQ01). None requires new experiments; all are one-sentence hedges.
